offlineLock.lockedDescription: Unlock with your PIN to view and send drafts stored on this device.
offlineLock.setupTitle: Set a PIN for offline drafts
offlineLock.setupDescription: Drafts containing customer names, notes, photos and signatures are encrypted on this device. You must unlock with your PIN after a restart or 15 minutes of inactivity.
offlineLock.legacyDescription: Drafts from an older version are stored unencrypted on this device. Set a PIN to encrypt them, or discard them. Nothing is deleted without your confirmation.
offlineLock.orphanedDescription: Encrypted drafts exist, but the key that can unlock them is missing from this browser. The drafts cannot be recovered. Discard them to set a new PIN.
offlineLock.discardConfirm: Discard all local drafts and remove the PIN from this device? This cannot be undone.
offlineLock.legacyDiscardConfirm: Discard drafts from an older version without encrypting them? This cannot be undone.
offlineLock.pinHint: At least {min} digits. The PIN is not stored and cannot be recovered.
offlineLock.pinTooShort: The PIN must be at least {min} digits.
offlineLock.pinInvalid: The PIN may only contain digits.
offlineLock.lockedOut: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
offlineLock.cryptoUnavailable: Encryption is not available in this browser. Offline drafts cannot be stored safely.
offlineLock.keyCorrupt: The PIN key cannot be read. Discard the drafts and set a new PIN.
offlineLock.keyMissing: No PIN was found for this user. Set a new PIN.
